title: Horizon and Echo Revisited
author: Juniper Lockridge
blurb: Noor Eastwick, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
